route_execution_ineligible_skip_rule: skip only when the frozen route has an ordinary action failure in a fresh-reset no-placement baseline, route contract and reset restoration remain valid, and no fatal error occurs
route_construction_failure_skip_rule: a deterministic over-limit or unsupported-route result may be recorded and skipped; contract mismatch, reset failure, launch failure, or other integrity/runtime errors must stop
native_gate: native qualification is prohibited unless public baseline route-execution evidence passes and matches scene, route digest, and action count
stop_condition: stop after six distinct R1 scenes have fully qualified anchors
claim_boundary: scene eligibility and anchor qualification only; not a memory-agent comparison or formal episode
